title: The Awakening

shots.visual: Dr. Infinity races through a collapsing underground laboratory under red emergency lights carrying a damaged research drive.
shots.audio: alarms, smoke, distant impacts, tense original score
shots.dialogue: If you're seeing this, Diamond... then I failed to keep them away from you.

shots.visual: Dr. Infinity faces the camera beside an empty containment chamber as an unnatural shadow moves behind him.
shots.dialogue: The serum was never the experiment.

shots.visual: Diamond wakes from the nightmare and grips his blue diamond pendant as it pulses with faint energy.
shots.audio: quiet room tone, alarm, subtle energy pulse
shots.dialogue: Dad... Great. Another normal day. Okay. Maybe not.

shots.visual: Diamond works on an energy prototype; the pendant pulses and a mysterious symbol appears on the monitor.
shots.audio: lab ambience, electronics, rising mystery music

shots.visual: Diamond discovers his father's encrypted recording and watches as the warning about the Bloodline is revealed.
shots.dialogue: There are people searching for something called the Bloodline. Do not trust anyone who tells you they know what happened to me.

shots.visual: The college campus suddenly loses power; students flee while Diamond investigates a distant scream.
shots.audio: power shutdown, crowd panic, distant scream

shots.visual: An original supernatural hunter attacks; Diamond protects a student and studies its movement before being overwhelmed.
shots.audio: fast combat impacts, debris, escalating score
shots.dialogue: Left shoulder drops before it strikes. Got you.

shots.visual: Diamond's pendant cracks; electric-blue energy erupts, his eyes ignite blue, luminous markings appear across his arms and the environment reacts to his pressure.
shots.audio: heartbeat, energy surge, powerful original awakening motif

shots.visual: Diamond moves with accelerated perception and lands a controlled blue-energy counterattack that sends the hunter through the pavement.
shots.dialogue: Whatever this is... my father knew.

shots.visual: An unknown faction watches Diamond's awakening on a massive display and prepares hunters.
shots.dialogue: The Bloodline has awakened. Then Diamond Infinity is alive. Prepare the hunters.

shots.visual: Close-up of Diamond's cracked pendant as blue energy flickers; cut to black and reveal the next episode title.
